hypothesis: Seed-averaging the best full-view neural arch (PLR-MLP, fold-0 standalone 0.960197) reduces idiosyncratic variance and lifts standalone AUC toward the champion (~0.9619) without changing the inductive bias, potentially flipping port_delta toward positive.
why_this_arch: PLR-MLP full-view is the best standalone of the neural block (0.960197) and the cheapest (~18s/run). Periodic numerical embeddings are the most distinct bias vs the boosted-tree aux10.
protocol: identical to neural fold-0 screen (train on FIT, inner 10% ES fold-safe, predict fold-0, champion hash-asserted); only the torch/numpy/python seed varies (seeds 1..4; seed-1 already exists as plrmlp_full_fold0). Equal-logit average of the 4 saved fold-0 predictions = the multi-seed member.
screen_metrics_bar: promising if ensemble portfolio_delta >= +5e-5 AND logit_pearson_vs_portfolio < 0.995
view: full (285-feature certified rich view, fold-safe TE)
negative_rule: if 4-seed averaging does not lift standalone past ~0.961 or port_delta stays negative, close the multi-seed lever for this arch: seed variance is not the binding constraint (correlation with the champion is).
anti_leakage: each seed trained on FIT only, inner ES fold-safe, EVAL labels never read; ensemble averages only saved fold-0 predictions.
